subject: [hw] V16 -> V02: exact decode masks for t32_mem/t32_misc (and the B.W/B<c>.W discriminator)
body:
V16 is implemented and green (3284917 checks). Exact routing instructions, so your t32_route table matches the class:

t32_mem is entered for:
  A) (hw1 & 0xFE00) == 0xE800  (0xE800-0xE9FF), all of it:
     - hw1 bit 6 == 0 -> LDM/STM. bit7=1,bit8=0 -> IA; bit8=1,bit7=0 -> DB; other combos UNDEF.
       W = hw1 bit 5, L = hw1 bit 4.
     - hw1 bit 6 == 1 -> LDRD/STRD, LDREX/STREX, TBB/TBH, with P=bit8, U=bit7, W=bit5, L=bit4:
         (0,0,0): STREX(L=0)/LDREX(L=1);  (0,1,0): hw2[15:12]=4/5/7 exclusive B/H/D,
         =0xF TBB/TBH; P=1 or P=0,W=1 -> LDRD/STRD.
  B) (hw1 & 0x0E00) == 0x0800  (0xF800-0xF9FF), load/store single + PLD/PLI/PLDW.
     Your current rules are right: 0xF8xx -> t32_mem, 0xF9xx with hw1 bit 4 set -> t32_mem
     (0xF9xx with bit 4 clear is the NEON structure space). Inside the class op = hw1[7:4]
     must be 0-5 or 8-13; op 6/7/14/15 and 0xF9C/0xF9D return UNDEF.
  Everything else in those two regions -> UNDEF.

t32_misc (what you already route there): hw1 0xF000-0xF7FF with hw2 bit 15 set, coprocessor
words 0xEC00-0xEEFF / 0xFC00-0xFDFF with cp != 10/11.  Decode:
  hw2[15:14]==10, hw2 bit12==0, hw1[9:6] < 0xE  -> B<c>.W  (21-bit immediate)
  hw2[15:14]==10, hw2 bit12==1                  -> B.W     (25-bit immediate)
  hw2[15:14]==11, hw2 bit12==1                  -> BL
  hw2[15:14]==11, hw2 bit12==0                  -> BLX (immediate), Align(PC,4)-relative,
                                                   switches to ARM state
  hw1[9:6]==0xE with bit12==0 is accepted as the AL spelling of B.W.
  MRS/MSR/hints/barriers are recognised only when hw2[15:12]==8 with their exact masks; a
  BLX can share hw1 with MRS/hints (e.g. hw1=0xF3AF), so the first halfword alone must NOT
  route a word away from the branch decode.
  UDF.W: (hw1 & 0xFFF0)==0xF7F0 && hw2[15:12]==0xA -> STOP_UNDEF.
  MRC p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3 (word & 0x0FFF0FFF == 0x0E1D0F70) -> Rt = tpidruro; every other
  coprocessor word -> UNDEF.  SVC/BKPT are 16-bit only.

One correction for the table comment you inherited from the plan: the discriminator between
B.W and B<c>.W is hw2 bit 12, not hw1 bits 9-6.  llvm-mc, lld and the vendor libraries all
encode B.W as hw1 = 1111 0 S imm10 with hw2 bit 12 = 1 (e.g. b.w #0 = f000 b800), and
b<c>.W with bit 12 = 0 (bne.w #0 = f040 8000); hw1[9:6] are imm10 bits 9-6 in B.W.  Verified
over the whole immediate range against llvm-mc and lld and on libvcodecdrv.so branches.
